definitions.gloss: distant view; looking far away; gazing into the distance
definitions.explanation: The act of looking at something far away, or the view itself seen from a distance. A literary and descriptive word often used for scenic landscapes.

examples.english: To gaze at the sea from the mountaintop.

examples.japanese: {遠望|えんぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Looking into the distance, I could see the shape of Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{晴|は}れた→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠|とお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{島々|しまじま}→島々：21165_shimajima⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{遠望|えんぼう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: From the observation deck, you can see distant islands on clear days.

notes:
Composed of {遠|えん} (far, distant) and {望|ぼう} (to gaze, to hope). A somewhat literary word used in descriptive writing, travel guides, and scenic descriptions. Also functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {遠望|えんぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to gaze into the distance).

USAGE:
Often appears in travel writing, photography descriptions, and literary prose. More evocative and formal than simply {遠|とお}く⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look far away).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠望|えんぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to gaze into the distance
- {遠望|えんぼう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ — can be seen from afar
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遠望|えんぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to view a mountain from the distance

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧ — panoramic view; broader, often from an elevated vantage point
- ⟦{眺望|ちょうぼう}→眺望：20013_choubou⟧ — view, prospect; similar but emphasizes the scenery being viewed
- ⟦{望遠|ぼうえん}→望遠：15552_bouen⟧ — telephoto, far-seeing; same kanji reversed, used in ⟦{望遠|ぼうえん}レンズ→望遠レンズ：24644_bouenrenzu⟧ (telephoto lens)
